items.title: S&P affirms Uruguay at BBB+ with stable outlook amid fiscal discipline push
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings affirmed its 'BBB+' long-term foreign and local currency sovereign credit ratings on Uruguay, maintaining a stable outlook as rising monetary credibility helps balance persistent fiscal pressures and a near-term growth slowdown. The rating agency expects the general government deficit to hold near 3.7% of GDP this year before gradually easing toward 3% by 2029, supported by recent tax reforms and spending containment.
